Countdown to the Challengers event Energamo Lipnolopet 2026

by Leandro Lutz • 09.09.2026
Photo: Bóša Fotograf/Energamo Lipnolopet
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:37
Instaread
The Ski Classics Challengers event Energamo Lipnolopet starts in less than a month. The roller ski race in classic technique will take place on October 3, 2026, in Frýdava, Czech Republic.

The Ski Classics Challengers event Energamo Lipnolopet starts in less than a month. The roller ski race in classic technique will take place on October 3, 2026, in Frýdava, Czech Republic.

On Saturday, October 3, Energamo Lipnolopet will take place in the Czech Republic, and for another year as a Ski Classics Challengers event.

Ski Classics Challengers event

The 55km event begins with flat terrain around Lake Lipno, located on the Czech-Austrian border, before transitioning into an undulating middle section with stunning views of the Alps.

The grand finale is a demanding 5km uphill to Svatý Tomáš (St. Thomas), where gradients reach up to 20% in some parts. Energamo Lipnolopet offers everything professional and recreational skiers could want in a long-distance roller ski race.

The Lake Lipno region is rich in natural beauty and offers a variety of outdoor activities, including wellness hotels, cycling trails, water sports, ski slopes, and tree-top paths. It is also easily accessible from several airports, including Prague (2 hours 30 minutes), Vienna (3 hours), Salzburg (2 hours 30 minutes), and Munich (3 hours 30 minutes).

Also Read: Vesterheim and Schützová winners of Energamo Lipnolopet 2025

Alongside the main 55km event, Saturday’s program also includes shorter distances (22km, 9km, and an 11km uphill trail run race). On Friday, a city sprint will take place in Frymburk, with a 1km course.

Energamo Lipnolopet is also part of the ED Skiroll Classics series, organized by the Pro Team, eD system RSJ Team. The event serves as the grand finale of the series and is included in the Ski Classics Challengers calendar.

Energamo Lipnolopet 2026 – Facts

  • Date: Saturday, October 3, 2026
  • Location: Frýdava
  • Country: Czech Republic
  • Race Distance: 55km 
  • Technique: Roller ski classic
  • Website: Energamo Lipnolopet   
  • Registration: Energamo Lipnolopet    
  • Instagram: Energamo Lipnolopet   
  • Facebook: Energamo Lipnolopet   

Ski Classics Challengers

Energamo Lipnolopet is a Ski Classics Challengers event. Pro Team registered athletes can collect points for the Ski Classics Champion and Youth competitions in their respective genders. 

A list of Ski Classics Challengers events with confirmed dates for Season 2026/2027 can be found at Ski Classics. The list is updated continuously with new events.
